Get the BFS data or tables catalog (deprecated)

Source: R/bfs_get_catalog.R
bfs_get_catalog.Rd

Deprecated since BFS 0.5.6: use bfs_get_catalog_data() or bfs_get_catalog_tables() instead.

Usage

bfs_get_catalog(language = "de", type = "data")

Arguments

language

Language of the catalog: "de" (default), "fr", "it" or "en".

type

"data" (default) or "tables".

Value

The result of bfs_get_catalog_data() or bfs_get_catalog_tables().
